name: linear-synthetic

notices.title: Default hyperparameters
notices.text: All policies used the **values from their papers**: alpha=1 for LinUCB, ConfidenceBall1, LinUCB_AB, LinUCB_RP, CBRAP, SOFUL and CBSCFD; alpha=1, lambda_=1 for LinTS. LinUCB, ConfidenceBall1, LinUCB_AB and LinUCB_RP used the **OFUL radius** (Abbasi-Yadkori et al., 2011). For ConfidenceBall1, it is much tighter than the radius of its paper (Dani et al., 2008). These values are safe in theory, except for LinUCB_AB, LinUCB_RP and CBRAP: they have **no regret guarantee** (see below). In practice, they often **explore too much**. The regret can then be higher than with tuned values.
notices.todo: Search the best values with param_grid=True. Or set them yourself, e.g. LinUCB(alpha=0.1).

notices.title: No regret guarantee
notices.text: LinUCB_AB, LinUCB_RP and CBRAP have **no proven regret bound**. LinUCB_AB: arm buckets can miss the best action. LinUCB_RP: the bound of the full-dimension algorithm does not hold after a random projection. CBRAP: its erratum (arXiv:1903.08600) gives a regret bound with a term linear in T. Their results can still be good, but nothing bounds their regret.
notices.default: Policies as in their papers: no projection, no buckets, no k-means (n_components=None, n_buckets=None, user_model="shared").
notices.todo: For a regret bound, pick a policy that has one (its docstring says), or turn off its heuristic option.

notices.title: Values with no theoretical choice
notices.text: Some policies kept defaults with **no value from theory**: lambda_=0.1 (any lambda > 0 keeps the bound valid) for all policies except LinTS; delta=0.01 (any delta in (0, 1): the bound holds with probability 1 - delta) for all policies. Other values can give a lower or a higher regret.
notices.default: These values (each policy's docstring explains them).
notices.todo: Search them with param_grid, e.g. param_grid={"lambda_": [...]}. Or set them, e.g. LinUCB(lambda_=1).

notices.title: Arm buckets (heuristic)
notices.text: LinUCB_AB ranked the actions by UCB and grouped them into buckets. At each step, it searched one bucket only. This is faster, but it can **miss the best action**. The regret bound **no longer holds**.
notices.default: No buckets: every action is searched (n_buckets=None).
notices.todo: Set n_buckets=None to search every action. Set bucket_by_ucb=False to rank by estimated mean.

notices.title: Not stored
notices.text: This run **did not store** the pseudo-regret, n_buckets and sketch_error over time, and the action of every step. The charts cannot show them.
notices.default: Regret, reward, CPU time and wall time only (track=(), measure_memory=False).

notices.text: The curves kept one value every 15 steps. Between two kept steps, the line is **drawn, not measured**. You set log_interval=15.
